items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: When I first met him, I was working at the Navy Yard and I used to hear them fellas practicing over there.

ctx.x: I don't know. I must have been about 15 or 16 years old at that time. So, my man said, you can't get no work. Yeah, I left. That made me feel bad. I left. That made me feel bad.
The last interview we had a month ago, you were telling about the trombone players like Eddie Benson over in Algiers. Could you tell us some more about him when you first met him?
When I first met him, I was working at the Navy Yard and I used to hear them fellas practicing over there.
